Title: Hive
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-3
Content: Apache Hive is a data warehouse project that sits on top of Apache Hadoop. The Apache Hive driver is not bundled with this connector and therefore must be added to the Java execution classpath. See the Custom Driver config section for more details. The JDBC connector supports a number of Hive specific features. To enable these features, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to custom, with solidatus.jdbc.driver-class set to the Hive JDBC class. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to hive.
Title: Changelog
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/changelog
Content: [SOL-10919] [SQLParsing] [Hive] Fix Hive error when parsing metadata json
[SQLParsing] [BigQuery] Fix SUBSTR function integer inputs being counted as column sources
